newsitem.title: UK: UK car production up 6.9% in six months to Feb.
newsitem.headline: UK car production up 6.9% in six months to Feb.

text.p: Total car production in Britain rose by a seasonally adjusted 6.9 percent in the six months ending February, compared with the previous six months, the Office for National Statistics said on Thursday.
Production allocated for export jumped nine percent, while home production rose by 4.5 per cent.
Compared with the same period a year ago, total car production rose by 16.4 percent, seasonally adjusted, with export production up 34 percent and home production just 0.2 percent higher.
Total commercial vehicle production, seasonally adjusted, was 2.0 percent up on the previous six months and 13.7 per cent up on the same period a year ago, the ONS said.
